reuse.why: Uses the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard, findOrCreateBank and syncAccount, but copies the whole link routine and the Akahu download routine instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkSimpleFinAccount/linkAkahuAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the URL and log text changed.

placement.why: New code sits where each provider's link, download and server-path code already lives, following the tree's per-provider layout.

scope.why: Besides the feature, it reformats the assertBankAccountNotLinked call in all five existing link functions, which is unrelated churn.

maintainability.why: Adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a second identical downloader, so any fix to linking or downloading must be repeated in more places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The shared assertBankAccountNotLinked guard and the syncAccount dispatch are used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied link and download functions are verbatim copies under a new name, not disguised.
